title: Transfer a Package
description: Copy or upload the deployed package to a file share or HTTP feed endpoint.

Octopus.Action.TransferPackage.Destinati.label: Destination path
Octopus.Action.TransferPackage.Destinati.helpText: Local path or UNC share. Used when destination type is 'file'.

Octopus.Action.TransferPackage.Destinati.label: Destination URL
Octopus.Action.TransferPackage.Destinati.helpText: HTTP(S) endpoint. Files are PUT to {url}/{filename}.

Octopus.Action.TransferPackage.Destinati.label: Username
Octopus.Action.TransferPackage.Destinati.helpText: Optional. Basic-auth username for HTTP destinations.

Octopus.Action.TransferPackage.Destinati.label: Password
Octopus.Action.TransferPackage.Destinati.helpText: Optional. Basic-auth password for HTTP destinations.

Octopus.Action.TransferPackage.FileNameP.label: File name pattern
Octopus.Action.TransferPackage.FileNameP.helpText: Glob pattern(s), comma- or newline-separated. Defaults to all files.
